blind_target.authors: Lackner T, Müller A, Pankraz A, Becher P, Thiel H-J, Gorbalenya AE, Tautz N.
blind_target.title: Temporal modulation of an autoprotease is crucial for replication and pathogenicity of an RNA virus.
blind_target.evidence_quote: The observation that the NS2-5B/NCP7 WT replicon exhibited a lower replication efficiency than the NS2-5B/CP7 WT replicon in naive MDBK cells at 24 h and 48 hpe argues that the DNAJC14-mediated temporal regulation mechanism of NS2-3 cleavage during the replication of the NS2-5B/NCP7 WT replicon contributes to this lower replication efficiency and is in line with the lower RNA replication efficiency known for NCP7 infections than CP7 infections (14).
blind_target.outcome_quote: The observation that the NS2-5B/NCP7 WT replicon exhibited a lower replication efficiency than the NS2-5B/CP7 WT replicon in naive MDBK cells at 24 h and 48 hpe argues that the DNAJC14-mediated temporal regulation mechanism of NS2-3 cleavage during the replication of the NS2-5B/NCP7 WT replicon contributes to this lower replication efficiency and is in line with the lower RNA replication efficiency known for NCP7 infections than CP7 infections (14).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The new replicon experiment explicitly compares and agrees with the reported NCP7-versus-CP7 RNA replication difference.

blind_target.authors: Lackner T, Thiel H-J, Tautz N.
blind_target.title: Dissection of a viral autoprotease elucidates a function of a cellular chaperone in proteolysis.
blind_target.evidence_quote: Our experiments reemphasize that, mechanistically, the cochaperone function of the DNAJC14 J-domain (essential for the association between J-domain proteins with chaperones of the Hsp70 family [85]) is not required for NS2 activation, as proposed earlier (53).
blind_target.outcome_quote: Our experiments reemphasize that, mechanistically, the cochaperone function of the DNAJC14 J-domain (essential for the association between J-domain proteins with chaperones of the Hsp70 family [85]) is not required for NS2 activation, as proposed earlier (53).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The isolated-domain rescue tests whether the previously reported NS2 activation operates without the cochaperone J-domain. Authors explicitly confirm the specific earlier proposal.
